# UX Review

## Inputs
- Screens/flows changed
- Copy changes
- Accessibility scope

## Procedure
1. Verify calm and nonjudgmental language.
2. Verify loading/error/empty/offline states.
3. Verify keyboard navigation and screen-reader semantics.
4. Verify responsive mobile behavior.

## Output Contract
- UX findings
- Accessibility findings
- Recommended adjustments
